name: ucu
description: Let AI agents use your Mac's apps in the background, without touching your mouse or taking focus.
long_description:
UCU is a local MCP server that lets agents read and operate native Mac apps through the accessibility tree. Apps it drives stay on a private desktop and can't take your focus, the `safari` and `chrome` tools work in the agent's own window, and every app is approved except the ones you deny in ~/Library/Application Support/ucu/policy.json. It runs on agent-desktop from Vercel Labs.

This bundle is for Apple silicon Macs. The app that runs your MCP client needs Accessibility permission, and Screen Recording for screenshots.
